item.title: Spotter 0.9.23
item.description:
Spotter 0.9.23

  • Force Quit from the menu bar. Click Spot, then Force Quit… in the middle of the bottom row (or right-click Spot). Spotter asks before it quits anything.
  • Safe to install, and it says so. Settings → About shows that Spotter is notarized by Apple, runs on this Mac and never uploads your files, with a way to check it yourself.
  • The films end on "Your Mac, understood."
  • Small fixes. One date style everywhere, a picture on the welcome film before it plays, clearer messages for links to deleted cards, quieter Health when nothing needs doing.

item.title: Spotter 0.9.22
item.description:
Spotter 0.9.22

  • Help for every feature. Click ? beside any page title, or right-click a sidebar item and choose How Does This Work?, for a short video and the steps. Help ▸ Spotter Help lists them all.
  • Send Feedback. Help ▸ Send Feedback… shows exactly what is sent, and a person reads every message.
  • Ask Spot understands you better. Ask what it can do, how to reach us, or to switch Spotter to dark, and it answers directly instead of searching your files. It is in beta and says so; you can turn it off in Settings → Intelligence to save memory.
  • Duplicates in one click. Move N Copies to the Trash… now includes copies made today, shows the list first, and one Undo brings them all back.
  • Fixes. Settings… in the menu bar opens Settings again; the tour outlines exactly what it is talking about; the film can play faster; setup turns on the most useful things for you.
